name: scorm-kit
description: Parse SCORM 1.2 / 2004 (3rd, 4th Ed) packages from Articulate Rise 360, Storyline 360 or plain HTML into an LLM-ready kit and build pages from it.

interface.shortDescription: Turn SCORM packages into LLM-ready content
interface.longDescription: Reads SCORM 1.2 and 2004 (3rd/4th Edition) packages from Articulate Rise 360, Storyline 360 or plain HTML SCOs. Exports instructions.md, per-unit markdown, questions with answer keys, assets and a viewer page, so you can rebuild the course as HTML, a quiz bank, slides or a summary.
